description: Compare two or three exact public home-insurance formulas on the same documentary criteria, with conditions, limits, deductibles and source citations. Start with no arguments to discover available formula_ids and coverage_ids. IDs include the document version. Missing cells never inherit product-level facts or another formula. No ranking, price, current availability or personal coverage inference. Only formulas with already-publishable facts are listed.
name: compare_public_insurance_formulas
